en:
You learned about Sporting Goods.
...Time to get clicking!
Get this Kamiyama guy to make you some custom baseball equipment.
Howdy, Coach. I'm back again.
Ah, yes. I've been waiting for you.
Now, I have to ask, what kind of batting equipment are you using these days?
As in, like, bats and gloves? Mm, the stuff I use is all store-bought.
Mhm. I thought I wouldn't need to say this, but you really should be using better gear.
But all I have access to is stuff off the shelves. Is that really so bad?
You of all people should know the value of high-grade equipment, especially since you actually used to use it.

Yeah, but that was ages ago. My days of having fun with
league-worthy equipment are long gone, unfortunately.
Huh. Well. You have any friends who are craftsmen?
You mean, like, someone who could make me equipment on their own? Nope, don't have a clue.
I know one man⑬his name's Kamiyama. Operates out of a van somewhere in town.
Yeah? Don't you think that seems... kinda shady?
That it does. I'm unfamiliar with the details myself. So your assignment is to get him to make you some baseball equipment.
That's it? Can't I at least get some more clues?
You could, if I had any. Sounds like you've got a challenge on your hands.
That said, maybe that's part of my intention. <Italic>Maybe</Italic> I assigned this to you because I'm convinced you can do it.
But that's not fair!
Hahaha. Don't you live here? I'm sure there are plenty of ways you can track down your quarry.
Okay... I'll go look.
I do know someone like that. He's a guy named Kamiyama, and he makes all these fancy weapons...
Oh, good. Then I don't have to bother with a long-winded explanation. What I want is for you to go have this Kamiyama guy make you some gear.
Okay. I'll go ask him.
I doubt it'll be as simple as that, but best of luck to you.
Uh... thanks?
Yay! Karaoke with Akiyama-san! The only question is, what should I have you sing?
What would be a good song for you? Hmm... There're just so many good ones!
You're sure a good singer, Akiyama-san. And you looked so cool, too.
Now, let's hear you sing, Haruka-chan.
Okay, I'll do my best!
Sorry, but I don't feel like it today.
What happened, Akiyama-san?
Sorry... I was a little off there.
That was so cool, Akiyama-san! It sounded like I was listening to a professional singer!
That really means something from a pro like you.
You're up next, Haruka-chan. Can't wait to hear you sing.
I nailed that one thanks to you, Akiyama-san!
Don't sell yourself short, Haruka-chan. That was all you.
Akiyama-san, you made it really hard to sing.
Yeah, that was totally my fault.
I really nailed that one thanks to you, Akiyama-san!
Heh. Don't mention it.
Yay! Karaoke with Akiyama-san! Now what should I sing today...
Nicely done, Haruka-chan. Like the true pro you are.
I know, right? Hehehe...
I want to hear you sing, too, Akiyama-san!
A bit off your game today?
I guess so...
That was great, Haruka-chan. I'm a fan for life.
I really nailed that one!
You made that really fun, Haruka-chan. That felt great.
You were so cool, Akiyama-san!
Was that a tough one?
Sorry, Akiyama-san...
Haruka-chan, you sure know how to get things fired up.
That was so cool, Akiyama-san! It sounded like a pro was singing.
I'd like some <Color:8>Ballantine's 30 Years<Color:Default>.
(Honoka-chan wants to drink some <Color:8>Ballantine's 30 Years<Color:Default>.)
Cheers!
Thanks for the drink!
Please come again anytime.
I see. We hope you'll come by again.
You're underage, aren't you, miss? I'm sorry, but I can't serve you alcohol.
I'm sorry to bother you. I'm actually looking for someone, and I think they may have been here.
Did you see someone who looked like a dance instructor?
A dance instructor? I'm not sure I'd know one if I saw one.
Um, I'm sorry. That was too vague, wasn't it?
(Maybe I just asked the wrong question. What if I tried asking a different way?)
How am I supposed to know someone's name just from looking at them?
I... I guess you're right. I'm sorry.
Was there a man here that was really tanned and dressed all flashy?
Oh, that guy? Yeah, he was here a little while ago.
He said he drank too much, so maybe he went to go sober up somewhere.
Thank you so much! I'll be on my way!
Welcome. Would you care for something to drink?
Sir, I think you've had enough. You may want to take it easy.
Care for another round, sir?
I'm not sure if you are aware, sir, but word is that nonalcoholic cocktails are selling like hotcakes nowadays.
What? Cocktails without alcohol?
Yes. Not only do they not have alcohol, but they also have zero calories and are sugar-free.
Sounds almost too good to be true.
Unlike normal cocktails, you can drink as much as you want and not get drunk or put on weight. They're perfect for a lady's night out.
They're also good for people who don't have a high alcohol tolerance, so they can still enjoy cocktails.
(Non-alcoholic cocktails, huh? I could talk about that at the cabaret club.)
You don't have any <Color:8>special worms<Color:Default>, do you? Here, take this.
You got <Color:8>Special Worm<Color:Default>.
This older gentleman came by and told me if some poor-looking guy showed up to fish and looked lost, I should give him that.
This girl I know has trouble with her throat. I'm wondering if you have any medicine that could help.
What are her symptoms?
She has no pain or swelling, but she's lost her voice.
She's got a job interview coming up. She needs to get her voice back, and fast.
Fast? Hmm...
Yeah. Is there a cure-all that might work for something like that?
Let me think...
Even the doctor she saw said they couldn't help, so I guess there isn't any quick fix, but still, if you know anything...
Wait a second. Maybe, just maybe, there is something.
Wait, really? What is it?
It's something I heard in a rumor, so I can't vouch for it...
That'll do. Let's hear it.
You know how Sotenbori's always been home to a lot of entertainers?
Apparently, it's not uncommon for these entertainers to lose their voice before they climb on stage.
They say there's a legendary lozenge that instantly restores voices like magic.
A legendary lozenge? Do you have any idea where I could find it?
I wouldn't know. That said, since it's not sold in stores, one might imagine you would need to look on the shady side of things.
How shady are we talking?
Well, <Color:255,200,200,255>Ashitaba Park<Color:Default>, for one. You can always find shady people loitering around there.
All right, Ashitaba Park, yeah?
Rumor says you can't just walk up to anyone and buy it. It's "legendary," after all. Seems only a chosen few can actually get their hands on it.
That's all I know. I'm sorry I can't be of more help.
No, that's great, thanks. You gave me enough to get started.
(A legendary lozenge, huh? Guess I'm headed to Ashitaba Park.)
Uncle Kaz, I'm a little tired, but a <Color:8>Tauriner<Color:Default> would pep me right up!
(Hmm. Looks like Haruka wants some <Color:8>Tauriner<Color:Default>.)
But... Without a <Color:8>Tauriner<Color:Default>, I'm gonna collapse!
Oh, and we're giving these out. Here, please take one.
You got a Prize Ticket.
Way to go, champ! You're now the top mahjong player in Kamurocho!
As the top mahjong player, you've got a target on your back. Up-and-coming players are going to be gunning for you.
Hey, good job. It looks like you're keeping your challengers at bay. Keep the wins coming, champ.
Hey, good job out there. Come on back whenever you want to try climbing the ranks.
'Ey boss. Would you like to exchange your winnings for prizes or purchase mahjong sticks?
Well, what do ya think?
Not now. I'll come back later.
All right. Well, registration's always open, so come back whenever you'd like to play a ranking match.
What will it be today? Will you play a Seiryo Cup match?
Sure, I'll play now.
Okay. Well, you're registered for ranked play, so you can play those matches anytime.

1st  10,000 points
2nd  5,000 points
3rd  -5,000 points
4th -10,000 points
I wonder what drives people to want second-hand designer merchandise.
I cannot imagine buying something that was worn by god knows who.
I'm sure there are some items that haven't been used at all. Actually, there's probably a lot like that.
Why would someone sell something they haven't used? That makes no sense at all.
You've never done that, Shion-chan? Like if you got a present from a customer that you didn't like?
Oh, yes, that. I suppose in that instance it would be better to give the item to someone who needed it.
Otherwise, it'd just be a waste. If I got any sort of present I'd put it to good use. There's no sense in letting it collect dust.
But what would you do if you received something you had no interest in, Shinada-san? Surely you'd sell it, no?
I'd try to use it if I could. Even if it wasn't exactly my thing, I might learn to like it.
Maybe that's just because I tend to be far more fond of things I didn't pick out for myself.
Oh, that's one way to think about it! Perhaps I should try to use the things my customers give me once in a while.
Yeah, well, I'm also the kind of guy who can't get rid of anything, so... maybe don't listen to me.
It's simple finances. If you can exchange it for cash, why not do that?
I suppose that's true. Then when you get the money for it, you can purchase something for yourself that you actually like!
Besides, isn't that sort of thing like a bonus for being a hostess?
Oh dear. Isn't expecting that kind of generosity from clients rather shameless?
No way! If a customer likes you, then they'll get you stuff that you want.
That's why you should be clear about what kind of things you like. Having to go exchange gifts for cash is a pain, after all.
Do you really think so? Perhaps I should start dropping more obvious hints.
Oh man, I only wish I could afford the sort of things you must want.
You don't sell them?
I make it a point to not accept something I don't need in the first place.
What!? That's a huge waste! If you don't want that stuff, I'll take it!
And whatever would you do with a ladies' purse, Shinada-san?
Bring it to a store like this one and exchange it for cash!
Well, I never! In that case, I'll just give you money to begin with. Isn't it rude to trade in a gift from someone for cash?
Well, what's the customer supposed to do with the purse after you've turned down the present?
Oh, this <Color:8>Pepper Spray<Color:Default> looks interesting. It could be quite useful in a pinch!
(Shion-chan's got her eye on that <Color:8>Pepper Spray<Color:Default>.)
Please take this. No charge.
Thanks for cheering me on, Uncle Kaz! I had a lot of fun singing!
Shinada-san, you're so good at this! You definitely have my respect.
Oh, that wasn't terribly fun.
Please call me anytime! <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
I'm heading back to Tokyo now! <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
Uncle Kaz, see if you can help me <Color:8>get at least 900 points on "So Much More!"<Color:Default>
(Haruka wants to <Color:8>score at least 900 points on "So Much More!"<Color:Default>)
Okay. Maybe next time then.
(Oh right. Coach Igarashi told me to score 800 points at karaoke.)
I was out in Tokyo, you know! Or had you forgotten about that?
...Yeah, I did.
Man, they sure got a lotta stuff here! I been here loads a times since they opened, but I still don't know where t'find anything.
That's all right. Think of it like a treasure hunt. It could be fun.
Nah, that's just over-thinkin' things! I just wanna see the things I wanna get!
But lotsa times I'll accidentally buy somethin' expensive, even if there's a better and cheaper thing right next to it.
That's not good. But, everything in this store is pretty cheap, so you shouldn't need to worry about that.
Ain't it a pain when y'go to the grocery store, though? Like, do ya focus on price, quality, or quantity?
I really gotta hand it to housewives who gotta keep that in mind when they go out shopping every day.
If you're not sure, don't buy it. If you get too flustered trying to make a decision, take some time to calm down and rethink your choice.
That'd sure save me some trouble. If I could pull it off, that is.
As long as it's not something you need to buy right away, you'll have plenty of other chances. Don't lose your cool when shopping.
